en.headline: Housing Bureau opens applications for all 13 light public housing projects
en.dek: With the final two school-conversion sites due in the first quarter next year, the full portfolio of about 30,000 units will be complete by end-March, ahead of the original five-year target.
body: The Housing Bureau announced on Friday that applications are now open for all 13 light public housing projects, as the final two sites converted from former school premises are scheduled for completion in the first quarter of next year.

The two remaining projects, on Shun Lee Tsuen Road in Kwun Tong and Chuk Yuen Road in Wong Tai Sin, will together provide about 210 units. The bureau said the entire stock of roughly 30,000 units will be finished by the end of March 2027, completing the programme in a little over four years and beating the five-year target set in the 2022 Policy Address.

Eligible applicants will begin receiving application forms by post from Friday. Forms returned by 6 November will receive priority processing; those who already submitted earlier forms need not reapply. After that date the bureau will continue to accept applications for all projects.
By the end of September the bureau had received more than 44,900 applications, it said.

zh.headline: 房屋局宣布簡約公屋13個項目全部開放接受申請
zh.dek: 最後兩個校舍改建項目明年首季落成，約3萬個單位將於明年三月底前全部完成，提前達標。
body: 房屋局周五宣布，即日起全部13個簡約公屋項目開放接受申請，最後兩個由校舍改建的項目預計明年第一季落成。
位於觀塘順利邨道及黃大仙竹園道的兩個新項目合共提供約210個單位。房屋局表示，全數約3萬個單位將於明年三月底前落成，僅需四年多完成，提前達到2022年施政報告提出的五年目標。
合資格人士今日起會陸續收到申請表，於11月6日或之前交回者可獲優先處理；早前已遞交表格者毋須再申請。之後房屋局將繼續開放所有項目供申請。
截至上月底，房屋局已收到超過44900份申請。
